Prashant Kishor Alleges BJP Plot to Merge JD(U)

Political strategist Prashant Kishor has alleged that agents of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) are working to merge the Janata Dal (United) with the BJP. Kishor also claimed that these agents are keeping Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar away from the process.
